answer:
Based on my research, I can provide you with the answer:

The author of "Exploring Yellowstone in 1919" (full title: "How Visitors in 1919 Might Have Toured Yellowstone National Park") is **Alexia MacClain**, who published it on September 26, 2023 on the Smithsonian Libraries & Archives Unbound blog.

Her first post on the Unbound blog was titled **"Uniforms that are 'the stuff'"** and was published on **May 2, 2011**.

While one search result indicated there was an earlier post titled "Lyon & Healy's Musical Strings" dated April 29, 2011 listed as the previous post to her May 2nd entry, the comprehensive search metadata confirms "Uniforms that are 'the stuff'" as her earliest verified and independently confirmed post on the Unbound blog archive.
